mode.description: Mode values: 0: Cgroup v2, 1: Cgroup v2 isolate, 2: CPU idle injection

performance_def.description: Default behavior when Performance power setting is used: -1: force off, 1: force on, 0: auto

balanced_def.description: Default behavior when Balanced power setting is used: -1: force off, 1: force on, 0: auto

powersaver_def.description: Default behavior when Power saver setting is used: -1: force off, 1: force on, 0: auto

hfi_lpm_enable.description: Use HFI LPM hints: 0: No, 1: Yes

hfi_suv_enable.description: Use HFI SUV hints: 0: No, 1: Yes

util_entry_threshold.description: System utilization threshold to enter LP mode from 0 - 100

util_exit_threshold.description: System utilization threshold to exit LP mode from 0 - 100

entry_delay_ms.description: Entry delay. Minimum delay in non Low Power mode to enter LPM mode.

exit_delay_ms.description: Exit delay. Minimum delay in Low Power mode to exit LPM mode.

entry_hyst_ms.description: Lowest hysteresis average in-LP-mode time in msec to enter LP mode. 0: to disable hysteresis support

exit_hyst_ms.description: Lowest hysteresis average out-of-LP-mode time in msec to exit LP mode. 0: to disable hysteresis support

ignore_itmt.description: Ignore ITMT setting during LP-mode enter/exit: 0: disable ITMT upon LP-mode enter and re-enable ITMT upon LP-mode exit, 1: do not touch ITMT setting during LP-mode enter/exit
